  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/memor}{Memor}: conversational memory across LLMs}{2025}
    {Lead developer, OpenSciLab. Manages the memory of a user's interactions with LLMs: past conversations can be tapped when prompting, and parts of an exchange with one model carried over to another, bridging otherwise isolated LLM instances.\projectstats{69 stars, 4 forks, 1,664 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/tocount}{ToCount}: lightweight token estimator}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Estimates token counts for LLM input using rule-based and ML methods, for prompt analysis and token budgeting. The design point is the cost of the answer: an exact count means loading a whole tokenizer.\projectstats{23 stars, 2 forks, 89 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/xnum}{XNum}: universal numeral system converter}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Converts digits across English, Persian, Hindi, Arabic-Indic, Bengali, and other numeral systems, auto-detecting mixed formats and converting only the numbers while leaving surrounding text untouched.\projectstats{36 stars, 1 fork, 250 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/ipspot}{IPSpot}: system IP address fetcher}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Reports both the private address a machine holds on its own network and the public address the internet sees it from, over IPv4 and IPv6.\projectstats{106 stars, 8 forks, 100 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/drux}{Drux}: drug release analysis framework}{2025}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Simulates and plots drug release profiles from mathematical models, an extensible and reproducible platform for quantitative analysis in pharmaceutical research.\projectstats{28 stars, 3 forks, 192 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/pymilo}{PyMilo}: Python library for ML I/O}{2024}
    {Co-developer, OpenSciLab. A flexible I/O interface for ML pipelines that serializes models into a transparent, non-executable format, so a model can be read before it is loaded rather than run on trust.\projectstats{170 stars, 8 forks, 405 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/opr}{OPR}: optimized primer design tool}{2024}
    {Developer, OpenSciLab. Designs, validates, and optimizes primers for PCR, qPCR, and sequencing, consolidating primer design tooling into abstracted Python objects.\projectstats{27 stars, 0 forks, 94 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://github.com/openscilab/nava}{Nava}: OS-native sound engine in Python}{2023}
    {Lead developer, OpenSciLab. Plays sound in Python with no dependencies and no platform restrictions on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Recognized on the \textbf{Real Python podcast}. Funded by a \textbf{PSF Software Development Grant}.\projectstats{163 stars, 6 forks, 1,607 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/SLPL/naab}{naab}: Farsi text corpus}{2022}

  \cventry
    {\href{https://huggingface.co/SLPL/Sharif-wav2vec2}{Sharif-Wav2Vec2.0}: Farsi speech recognition model}{2022}

  \cventry

Gained significant traction in Web3 and NFT communities.\projectstats{1,191 stars, 78 forks, 2,047 downloads/month}}

  \cventry
